a.xlink:title: Numerical Jacobian ∂f/∂x by central differences (step 1e-5, 20 eom() calls).
Full nonlinear equations of motion, ẋ = f(t, x, u).
Air-relative velocity in the body frame, using the config's fixed wind. Only jacobianB() uses this.
Canard roll moment (N·m) for airspeed v_mag and deflection zeta_rad: coeff · v² · ζ(deg).
CG position (m from nose) at time t.
Drag coefficient from the power-on table before burnout and the power-off table after.
Rate of change of pitch/yaw inertia (kg·m²/s). Constant during the burn, 0 after.
Rate of change of roll inertia (kg·m²/s). Constant during the burn, 0 after.
Pitch/yaw inertia (kg·m²) at time t: linear from I_0 to I_f during the burn.
Roll inertia (kg·m²) at time t: linear from I_3_0 to I_3_f during the burn.
Mass (kg) at time t: linear from m_0 down by m_prop during the burn, then m_f.
Thrust (N) from the thrust table. 0 before ignition, after burnout, or outside the table.
World-to-body rotation matrix (DCM) from a unit quaternion.
Speed of sound (m/s) in air at T_kelvin: √(1.4 · 287.05 · T).
Atmosphere and wind at alt_m, interpolated from the built-in weather profile.
Piecewise-linear table lookup with binary search. Clamps outside the table.
